{
 "path": "programs/task-f00918de.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Crop the rectangular 1-field; the isolated colored pixels select its orientation.
    rs = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) for v in row if v == 1]
    cs = [c for row in grid for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    box = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    h, w = len(box), len(box[0])
    outside = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
               if v not in (0, 1) and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1)]
    above = any(r < r0 for r, c in outside)
    below = any(r > r1 for r, c in outside)
    left = any(c < c0 for r, c in outside)
    right = any(c > c1 for r, c in outside)
    if above:
        # Vertical reflection
        return box[::-1]
    if below and left and not right:
        # Main-diagonal reflection (the examples with clues below/left)
        return [[box[c][r] for c in range(h)] for r in range(w)]
    if below and left and right:
        # Anti-diagonal reflection
        return [[box[h - 1 - c][w - 1 - r] for c in range(h)] for r in range(w)]
    if left and not right and not below:
        # Horizontal reflection
        return [row[::-1] for row in box]
    return box
"
}

             if v not in (0, 1) and r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1]

    if not inner or not outer:

    ac, bc = min(c for r,c,v in outer), max(c for r,c,v in outer)
    target = {}

    transforms = [
